items.title: Marsh Bets on Wilshire to Expand Wealth and Investment Business
items.summary: MRSH is acquiring Wilshire to expand its advisor-led wealth business, strengthen institutional investment offerings and diversify fee-based revenue streams.

items.title: Can Marsh Sustain Consulting Momentum Despite an Expected Q4 Slowdown?
items.summary: MRSH's AI-driven consulting growth supports earnings, but an expected fourth-quarter slowdown raises questions about sustaining momentum and profitability.

items.title: Accelerant Q3 Earnings: Will Underwriting Weakness Spoil the Show?
items.summary: ARX faces a projected Q3 earnings drop despite rising premiums and investment income, as weakness in underwriting and MGA Operations clouds the outlook.

items.title: GPN Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on Genius Growth, Margins Rise
items.summary: Global Payments tops Q3 earnings estimates, driven by strong Genius adoption and higher enterprise volumes, while expanding margins and progress on Worldpay integration support growth.

items.title: ALL Q3 Earnings Beat on Protection Services Unit Strength
items.summary: Allstate's Q3 earnings beat estimates by 38.8%, fueled by Protection Services growth and higher investment income, despite surging catastrophe losses.

items.title: Marsh (MRSH) Stock May Be 27% Undervalued Following AltamarCAM Deal

With the spotlight back on how efficiently Marsh turns invested dollars into long term value, the question is whether the current valuation fairly reflects those economics. items.title: FIS Q3 Earnings Meet Estimates, Revenues Beat on Banking Strength
items.summary: FIS' Q3 earnings meet estimates as revenues jump 27.1% on banking strength, but higher technology spending and conversion delays prompt a 2026 outlook cut.

items.title: Marsh Unveils BrightPath Retirement Solution With $116B in AUM
items.summary: Marsh launches BrightPath, a $116B retirement solution spanning six markets, aiming to boost recurring fee income and strengthen its global retirement business.
